info.title: GetApi
info.description:
## Authentication

All API endpoints require authentication. Include your API key in every request using **one** of the following methods:

**Option 1 — X-Api-Key header (recommended)**
```
X-Api-Key: ga_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

**Option 2 — Bearer token**
```
Authorization: Bearer ga_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

You can generate and manage API keys in your [dashboard](https://getapi.nl/dashboard).

## AI & Agent Payments (x402)

Sommige endpoints zijn ook direct betaalbaar voor AI-agents via het **x402**-protocol
(https://www.x402.org) — geen API key of account nodig. Stuur normaal een verzoek zonder
key; de server antwoordt met **HTTP 402** en een `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`-header:

```
PAYMENT-REQUIRED: <base64 JSON PaymentRequirements>
```

Deze base64 bevat o.a. `network`, `asset`, `amount` en `payTo`. Je agent signeert een
EIP-3009 *transferWithAuthorization* voor `amount` USDC op dat `payTo`-adres, encodeert
de signature als base64 en hertrailt het verzoek met:

```
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64 SignedAuthorization>
```

De server verifieert de handtekening via een facilitator, levert de data, en settleert de
betaling on-chain. In het succes-antwoord staat een `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`-header met de
transactie-informatie. Een eenmalige `nonce` voorkomt replay. Betalingen verlopen in USDC
op **Base**; de prijs volgt uit de `credit_cost` van het endpoint.

get.description:
Returns full BAG address data for a Dutch address, including BAG IDs,
usage purposes, surface area, build year, status, and GPS coordinates.
Data is sourced from the PDOK BAG open API (Landelijke Voorziening BAG).
Results are cached for 24 hours. The upstream timeout is 8 seconds;
if PDOK is unavailable the endpoint returns HTTP 503.
Source: [PDOK BAG](https://api.pdok.nl/lv/bag/open-api/v1_5)
get.summary: Address lookup by postcode and house number

503.description: Upstream source (PDOK) unavailable or timed out (8 s)

get.description:
Returns address suggestions for autocomplete functionality based on a partial query.
Useful for implementing address autocomplete in forms. Returns up to 10 suggestions
with full address details and BAG identifiers.

Results are cached for 1 hour.

Returns full BAG address data for a given BAG nummeraanduiding ID.
The nummeraanduiding ID is a 16-digit identifier from the BAG register.
Data is sourced from the PDOK BAG open API (Landelijke Voorziening BAG).
Results are cached for 24 hours. The upstream timeout is 8 seconds;
if PDOK is unavailable the endpoint returns HTTP 503.
Source: [PDOK BAG](https://api.pdok.nl/lv/bag/open-api/v1_5)

503.description: Upstream source (PDOK) unavailable or timed out (8 s)

post.description:
Validates a European VAT number via the official VIES system of the European Commission.
The country code must be the first two characters of the VAT number (e.g. `NL820646660B01`).
Supported countries: all 27 EU member states + Northern Ireland (XI).
When a member state provides it, the response includes the company name and address.

We use caching to mitigate VIES rate limits: valid numbers are cached for 24 hours, invalid numbers for 1 hour. When a member state is temporarily unavailable, we return a 503 status with an appropriate error message.

examples.message: BTW-nummer is ongeldig of niet geregistreerd.
The requested member state is temporarily unavailable via VIES.

get.description:
Returns all SBI codes from the local dataset. Optionally filter by `level` (1–5)
and/or `parent_code` to retrieve only the direct children of a given SBI code.

Levels: 1 = sectie (A–U), 2 = afdeling, 3 = groep, 4 = klasse, 5 = subklasse.

Source: [CBS Standaard Bedrijfsindeling 2025](https://www.cbs.nl/sbi)

results.title: Landbouw, jacht en dienstverlening voor de landbouw en jacht

get.description:
Searches through all SBI codes and titles using a free-text query.
Returns up to 25 matches, ordered by level (broad → specific) and code.

Source: [CBS Standaard Bedrijfsindeling 2025](https://www.cbs.nl/sbi)

Returns the title, description, level and full classification path for a single SBI code.
Accepts both the dotted CBS format (`64.92.3`) and the numeric format (`64923`).

Source: [CBS Standaard Bedrijfsindeling 2025](https://www.cbs.nl/sbi)
Data update: run `php artisan sbi:import` to refresh the local dataset.

path.title: Financiële dienstverlening (geen verzekeringen en pensioenfondsen), overig

get.description: Returns the NS records for the given domain. Results are cached for 10 minutes.

200.description: Nameservers found (of domein met geldige NS-records)

get.description:
Returns DNS records of the specified type for a domain.
Supported types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, PTR, SRV, ALL (default).
Results are cached for 5 minutes.
get.summary: DNS record lookup for a domain and record type

200.description: DNS records found (of geen records voor dit type)

post.description:
Checks an IP address against 5 public DNSBL / RBL zones (Spamhaus, SpamCop,
SORBS, Barracuda, PSBL) by querying their DNS-based blacklists. This is a
lightweight, realtime check without any external API calls or rate limits.
Results are cached per IP for 1 hour.

Useful for inbound mail filtering, form submission blocking, and general
IP reputation checks. Combine with our email validation APIs for a full
anti-spam suite.
post.summary: Check an IP address against DNS-based blacklists (RBLs)

get.description:
Zoekt omgevingsdocumenten (Omgevingswet én Wro) in samenhang op de opgegeven locatie.
Retourneert alle geldende plannen, omgevingsplannen en aanverwante documenten.
Accepteert coördinaten of postcode.

Source: [DSO Omgevingsinformatie Ontsluiten v2](https://developer.omgevingswet.overheid.nl/api-register/api/omgevingsinformatie-ontsluiten/)

examples.error: Locatie niet gevonden voor de opgegeven postcode.

get.description:
Zoekt ruimtelijke plannen (Wro) op de opgegeven locatie. Retourneert
bestemmingsplannen, inpassingsplannen en wijzigingsplannen die de locatie raken.
Accepteert coördinaten of postcode.

Source: [DSO Ruimtelijke Plannen Opvragen v4](https://developer.omgevingswet.overheid.nl/api-register/api/rp-opvragen/)

examples.error: Locatie niet gevonden voor de opgegeven postcode.

post.description: Checks the RFC format and verifies that the domain has a valid DNS or MX record.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

post.description:
Validates up to 25 email addresses in a single request.
Each address is checked for RFC format and DNS/MX record existence.
post.summary: Validate a batch of email addresses

post.description:
Checks the domain against a continuously updated blocklist of known
throwaway email services (Mailinator, Guerrilla Mail, 10minutemail, etc.).

examples.message: This domain is not known as disposable.
This email uses a known disposable/temporary domain.

get.description:
Returns address data for a Dutch postcode, optionally refined by house number.
There are multiple sources available with varying coverage and accuracy.

post.description:
Validates an IBAN (ISO 13616) fully offline: country-specific length + structure
and the mod-97 check digit. Supported for 70+ countries. For Dutch IBANs the
bank name and BIC are resolved from the bank code. An optional BIC can be
submitted to validate its format.

No external/network calls are made, so this endpoint is always available and
has no rate limits from any third party.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

get.description:
Returns location, ISP, organisation and hosting details for a given IP address.
Results are cached for 1 hour.
get.summary: Get ISP information and location details for an IP address

get.description:
Geeft een overzicht van alle milieuzones (lage-emissiezones en nul-emissiezones) in Nederland.
Data afkomstig van het NDW Open Data platform (DATEX II formaat).
Optioneel te pagineren met `page` (+ `per_page`, max 500; alleen dan bevat de
response een `meta`-blok). Filteren
op type zone of stad.

Geeft een lijst van alle openbaar toegankelijke laadpunten in Nederland.
Data afkomstig van het NDW Open Data platform (DOT-NL); per laadpunt worden
alle beschikbare bronvelden teruggegeven, inclusief de volledige
`availabilities` (aantallen, vermogen, stroomsoort, tarief-id's en
connectorformat per connector).
Optioneel te pagineren met `page` (+ `per_page`, max 500; alleen dan bevat de
response een `meta`-blok). Filteren
op stad, status, beschikbaarheid of connector type.

Geeft een overzicht van alle truckparkeerplaatsen in Nederland met actuele bezettingsinformatie.
Statische locatiedata wordt gecombineerd met dynamische bezettingsstatus (DATEX II).
Optioneel te pagineren met `page` (+ `per_page`, max 500; alleen dan bevat de
response een `meta`-blok). Filteren
op status, beschikbaarheid of weg.

Returns combined property data for a Dutch address: Address details + BAG identifiers, Energy label info,
property value (WOZ waarde), spatial planning data, and environmental information.

Het blok `energy_labels` bevat álle EP-Online-labels voor dit adres (volledige
records, inclusief historie); `energy_label`, `energy_details` en `building`
blijven het meest recente label in de gesubseteerde vorm weergeven.

This API combines multiple data sources and provides comprehensive property information
that is not easily available elsewhere. Also keep in mind that due the multiple underlying
API calls, the response time for this endpoint may be longer than typical lookup endpoints, especially on cache misses.

Results are cached for 24 hours.

spatial_planning.copyright: Gegevens geleverd door Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet (DSO-LV) onder CC-BY licentie.

environmental_info.copyright: Gegevens geleverd door Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet (DSO-LV) onder CC-BY licentie.

get.description:
Returns property data for a Dutch address: Address details + BAG identifiers, energy label info,
and building characteristics. Het blok `energy_labels` bevat alle EP-Online-labels
(volledige records); de samenvattende blokken tonen het meest recente label. This is the lightweight ("lite") version of the pandgegevens API:
it deliberately omits the costly WOZ-waarde and DSO spatial/environmental data for a faster
and cheaper response. For those, use the full `pandgegevens` API.

Results are cached for 24 hours.

Returns vehicle registration data from the RDW Basisregistratie Voertuigen,
enriched with fuel + emission information, a national milieuzone compliance
flag, and a wide range of extended fields: catalogusprijs, dimensions,
weight limits, body type, axle data and EV-specific specs (range, consumption,
continuous power). Results are cached for 24 hours.

Naast de gesubseteerde velden bevat de response het blok `rdw` met de
volledige bronrijen van alle vier RDW Open Data-datasets (Kenteken
Voertuigen, Brandstof, Carrosserie, Assen) — géén veld wordt weggelaten.
Kolommen die RDW voor een voertuig leeg laat, zijn `null`.

RDW registreert brandstof met 1 rij per brandstof (gesorteerd op
`brandstof_volgnummer`). `fuel_type` is de primaire brandstof (volgnummer 1);
`fuel_types` bevat alle geregistreerde brandstoffen en `hybrid` is `true`
zodra er meer dan één brandstof is (bv. Benzine + Elektriciteit). Zo is een
hybride auto te onderscheiden van een pure fossiel- of EV-auto.

The `allowed_in_green_zones` flag is derived from the emission class and fuel type
using Dutch national milieuzone standards (2024–2025):

— Electric / hydrogen / CNG: always allowed

— Petrol (any Euro class): allowed

— Diesel Euro 6+: allowed

— Diesel Euro 5 and below: not allowed

— Unknown fuel or emission class: `null`

For a cheaper, smaller response with only the core vehicle fields, see the
`vehicle-lite` endpoint.
get.summary: Vehicle lookup by Dutch license plate (kenteken) — Pro / extended response

404.description: License plate not found in RDW

get.description:
Returns the core vehicle fields (merk, model, kleur, brandstof, vermogen,
APK-status, milieuzone-vlag) from the RDW Basisregistratie Voertuigen.
Results are cached for 24 hours.

For a wider response including catalogusprijs, dimensions, body type,
axle data and EV-specs, use the `vehicle` (Pro) endpoint.
get.summary: Lightweight vehicle lookup by Dutch license plate (kenteken)

404.description: License plate not found in RDW

503.description: RDW Open Data service temporarily unavailable

get.description:
Returns the registered energy label(s) for a Dutch address from EP-Online (RVO).
Each label carries the complete EP-Online record (veldnamen zijn naar het
Engels vertaald; velden die EP-Online voor dit label niet bevat zijn `null`).
Results are cached for 24 hours.
Source: [EP-Online by RVO](https://ep-online.nl)
get.summary: Energy label lookup for a Dutch address

404.description: No energy label found for this address

post.description:
Uses a simple regex to extract email addresses from the HTML content of a given URL. It is not always possible
to extract email addresses due to obfuscation techniques. In such cases, the api will try to decode it. 

If it still fails, it will return an empty array. Leave feedback at info@wdnoord.nl if you have a webpage that 
contains email addresses but they are not extracted correctly and we will try to improve the regex or 
add support for the obfuscation technique used on that webpage.

200.description: One or more email addresses found on the page

404.description: URL unreachable or no email addresses found

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
